rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Tracks clipboard history with intelligent content classification and privacy features, exposing 15 tools for searching and retrieving clipboard items. Automatically identifies URLs, code snippets, JSON, SQL queries, and secrets using 252+ detection patterns, encrypting sensitive content with AES-256-GCM. Requires Touch ID biometric authentication to decrypt secrets. Full-text search is powered by SQLite FTS5 with window context tracking. Written in Rust, runs as a local background daemon with no cloud component.
